_friction_note: Live mode: real fees are in actual fills, no simulated friction
_require_confirmation_note: Must be false under Docker — no stdin prompt available
_min_note: Target $5.75 so liquidity-limited fills (can come in ~10-15% under target on thin 15-min books) still clear Polymarket's $5 notional floor. Observed case: $5.10 target → $4.97 fill at $0.66 because best-ask depth was only 7.52 shares. $5.75 → worst-case ~$4.89 becomes ~$5.00+.
_hybrid_note: Live trader is a pure consumer of the shared calc daemon (btc_pricer_15m_calc). Local worker is OFF; events arrive via the per-consumer inbox dir.
